lines.text: Many learners say: Today is 2026 November 16.

native.tip: 中文日期从大到小：年、月、日。美式英语相反，从小到大：先说月和日，最后说年。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “Today is 2026 November 16.”😅 中文是年月日，美式英语是月日年：“Today is November 16, 2026.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“Today is November 16, 2026.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Chinese dates go year, month, day, but American English goes month, day, year.
en.caption: Do you say “Today is 2026 November 16.” 😅 American dates go month, day, year: “Today is November 16, 2026.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
